title: dummyindex error envelope
description: Every new --json command (features-list, sessions list, toolkit *) prints this as the last JSON document on stdout and exits non-zero on failure. Extra keys are allowed (the engine may add fields such as hint; consumers ignore them). The GUI maps code to its own typed errors and shows message. code is an engine-defined snake_case string; the GUI treats unknown codes as a generic engine failure. Note: `status --json` does not print this envelope on usage errors in 0.37.0 (it writes text to stderr), which the GUI treats as EngineProtocol.
